name: South Dakota

office.name: South Dakota Highway Patrol Motor Carrier Services - Permit Center (SDAPS)

fees.note: Individual single-trip permit $25 (book of 10 self-issuing permits $250); one permit covers size and weight.

Plus $0.02 per ton (or fraction) that gross exceeds an axle-count base, per mile on state trunk highways, minimum $1. Base: 2 axles 40,000; 3 axles 60,000; 4 axles 80,000; 5 axles 85,000; 6 axles 90,000; 7+ axles 95,000 lb. Not modeled because the base depends on axle count.

escorts.when: Over 16' wide, on interstates and freeways
Over 20' wide, on two-lane and other roads

restrictions.text: Over 10' wide: daylight hours only (1/2 hour before sunrise to 1/2 hour after sunset).
Over 14'6" high: daylight hours only. Permit holder is responsible for all vertical clearances (SD DOT height restriction list).
Combination over 110' long: daylight hours only (also single units over 45', 2-unit combos with a unit over 60', 3+ unit combos with a unit over 48').

restrictions.when: Oversize, on two-lane and other roads
restrictions.text: Oversize on non-Interstate state highways more than 2 miles from an Interstate interchange: daylight hours only. Any move that needs an escort: daylight only.
Overweight-only permit vehicles may move at night if no escort is required. Overweight permits need DOT route approval first.
Oversize permit invalid when visibility is 1/2 mile or less; any OS/OW permit invalid on snow, ice, slush or frost-covered roads.

travel.when: Oversize, on two-lane and other roads

notes: Black Hills routes need escorts at lower widths: front escort over 10' wide on US-14A (Spearfish-US-85), US-85 (WY line-US-14A), parts of US-385, SD-44, SD-231, US-16A, SD-244, SD-87, SD-89, SD-36, SD-40, SD-473; front escort over 16' on US-16 (Keystone Wye-WY), parts of US-14A, US-385, SD-89, SD-85, SD-71, SD-471 (ARSD 70:03:01:20). Not modeled by route.
Multiple escorts and flagpersons required if the load extends more than 2' into an adjacent lane or traffic cannot pass without using the shoulder (ARSD 70:03:01:20.01).
No superload class, police-escort trigger, route-survey trigger or statewide weekend/holiday ban was found in ARSD 70:03:01; verify with SDHP whether holiday restrictions are applied on permits.
Only single-trip permits are issued for overweight on the Interstate.
